oral_examination.oral_examination: 47 Caries can be seen on the buccal side and pain is felt when probing, but the teeth are not loose.

source_handle: Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Remove the rot and expose the marrow, seal without arsenic deactivating agent, and temporarily seal with polycarboxylate.
